title: Critique: a minimal self of first-personal givenness has experiential reality

statements.text: In the phenomenological tradition the minimal self has experiential reality: it is the first-personal givenness, or mineness, of experience, the invariant dimension of first-personal givenness across changing experiences. Metzinger describes a pre-reflective self-acquaintance much like it, but the phenomenologists hold that a self is real if it has experiential reality.

sources.quote: the self referred to is not something standing beyond or opposed to the stream of experiences
The phenomenologists would argue that the self is real if it has experiential reality
